title: Loquiris bundled model manifest
description: Immutable provenance and runtime compatibility for one model artifact bundled into a Loquiris release.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest contract revision; increment before making a breaking schema change.

id.description: Stable identifier recorded in inference provenance.

version.description: Exact upstream release or immutable revision label.

source.description: Absolute HTTPS URI pinned to the exact reviewed upstream artifact; mutable branch or latest-release URLs are forbidden by release review.

artifactPath.description: Application-relative destination of the verified model bytes.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact artifact bytes.

bytes.description: Exact positive artifact length in bytes.

runtime.description: Adapter and model format that are allowed to load the artifact.

engineId.description: Stable engine-adapter identifier, such as whisper.cpp.

modelFormat.description: Container or tensor format interpreted by the adapter.

license.description: Fixed terms reviewed for redistribution of these exact bytes.

id.description: SPDX identifier or stable reviewed-license key.

snapshotPath.description: Application-relative path to the immutable reviewed license text.

capabilities.description: AI capabilities disabled if this artifact fails integrity checks.

enabledModes.description: Operating modes for which this exact artifact passed evidence gates.
